conbody.p: If Smart Cruise Control is temporarily canceled while Highway Driving Assist is operating, Highway Driving Assist switches to standby, but Lane Following Assist continues to operate.

li.p: After a stop caused by Emergency Stop, if Emergency Stop is canceled, Highway Driving Assist must be restarted to operate again.
If an interior camera is equipped, Highway Driving Assist operation may be restricted when the driver’s status cannot be detected.
